US Announces Landmark Nuclear Deal With Saudi Arabia

The US government announced a civilian nuclear cooperation deal with Saudi Arabia on Wednesday. The deal was reached after negotiations between the two countries, and it aims to promote peaceful use of nuclear energy in the region. The agreement includes provisions for the sharing of nuclear technology and materials, as well as safety and security measures. The US Department of Energy said the deal would help reduce the risk of nuclear proliferation in the Middle East. Saudi Arabia's King Salman confirmed the agreement, stating that it would enhance his country's ability to generate electricity and meet its energy needs.
